texts.at-0001: Round money only with round_money Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
texts.at-0002: Normalize unit prices with to_money Wrap raw line unit prices with ledgerly.money.to_money before arithmetic, and seed sums with ledgerly.money.ZERO, as line_total and invoice_total in ledgerly/invoice.py do.
texts.at-0003: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid billing input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with snake_case codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; do not use ValueError or bare exceptions.
texts.at-0004: Guard mutations with the draft status check Before mutating an invoice, check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}"), matching issue_invoice in ledgerly/invoice.py.
texts.at-0005: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
